description: Hidden validation test cases that Claude Opus 5.5 never sees during self-improvement repair loops to prevent overfitting or test-hacking.

cases.question: What is the recommended TTL for DNS changes during migration?
cases.expectedAnswer: Set TTL to 300 seconds (5 minutes) at least 24 hours prior to migration.

cases.question: Can customer service issue an unapproved discount on enterprise contracts?
cases.expectedAnswer: No, all discounts must be formally approved by the Sales Director in writing.

cases.question: Where should production database credentials be stored?
cases.expectedAnswer: In an encrypted environment vault (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager or Vault), never committed to code.
